chunks: Then We revived you after your death so that you might give thanks.

key_terms.بَعَثْنَاكُمْ: We revived you / We sent you forth

ai.seo_question: What does the Quran mean by being revived after death in Surah Al-Baqarah?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted as referring to the 'death' of the Children of Israel during their period of neglect or the death of their Prophet, followed by their revival to receive divine blessings. The emphasis on 'shukr' (gratitude) serves as a theological reminder that human existence and revival are not ends in themselves but opportunities to acknowledge God's favor through obedience and thankfulness.
